Summary: Verify login page shows the existing-feature elements
Description: Validates REQ-001; REQ-002; REQ-003; REQ-004; REQ-005
Test Step Action: Open the login page
Test Step Expected Result: Login page loads with VWO branding and a modern, minimalist login form

Test Step Action: Observe the login form
Test Step Expected Result: Email address field, password field, Remember Me checkbox and a free-trial signup link are displayed

Test Step Action: Observe the announcement banner
Test Step Expected Result: Banner highlights the new UI launch with Light and Dark Mode options

Summary: Verify login with valid email and password
Test Step Action: Open the login page
Test Step Expected Result: Login page displayed

Test Step Action: Enter registered email and correct password
Test Step Expected Result: Values accepted

Test Step Action: Click the sign-in control
Test Step Expected Result: Loading feedback is shown (see VWO-LOGIN-009)

Test Step Action: Observe the result after authentication completes
Test Step Expected Result: User is taken to the main VWO dashboard. A clear indication of successful login completion is shown. Success indication wording: Insufficient information to determine.

Summary: Verify login is rejected for valid email with incorrect password
Test Step Action: Open the login page
Test Step Expected Result: Login page displayed

Test Step Action: Enter registered email and an incorrect password
Test Step Expected Result: Values accepted

Test Step Action: Click the sign-in control
Test Step Expected Result: Login is not completed. A clear, actionable error message is displayed. Message wording: Insufficient information to determine.

Summary: Verify login is rejected for an unregistered email
Test Step Action: Open the login page
Test Step Expected Result: Login page displayed

Test Step Action: Enter an unregistered email and any password
Test Step Expected Result: Values accepted

Test Step Action: Click the sign-in control
Test Step Expected Result: Login is not completed. A clear, actionable error message is displayed. Message wording: Insufficient information to determine.

Summary: Verify field validation feedback appears on blur for empty fields

Test Step Action: Focus the password field, then move focus away without entering a value
Test Step Expected Result: Immediate validation feedback is shown. Feedback wording and whether empty is treated as invalid: Insufficient information to determine.

Summary: Verify email format validation on blur
Test Step Action: Enter a malformed email (test-design input) and move focus away

Test Step Action: Enter a well-formed email and move focus away
Test Step Expected Result: No format error is displayed

Test Step Expected Result: Page displays

Summary: Verify loading state during authentication
Precondition: Registered account exists; ability to throttle network

Test Step Expected Result: Clear feedback is shown while authentication is processing. Indicator type: Insufficient information to determine.

Summary: Verify clicking form labels focuses their fields
Test Step Action: Click the email label, then the password label
Test Step Expected Result: Each label is clickable and focuses its associated field. Inference (low confidence): clickable label means focus moves to its field. Based on REQ-019.

Summary: Verify Remember Me keeps the session persistent
Test Step Action: Log in with Remember Me checked
Test Step Expected Result: User reaches the dashboard

Test Step Expected Result: Persistent login session applies. Persistence duration and whether the user lands on the dashboard directly: Insufficient information to determine.

Summary: Verify session when Remember Me is not selected
Test Step Action: Log in with Remember Me unchecked
Test Step Expected Result: User reaches the dashboard

Test Step Action: Close the browser, reopen and open the login URL
Test Step Expected Result: Inference (low confidence): user must log in again. Based on REQ-003 (Remember Me provides persistence). Exact behavior: Insufficient information to determine.

Summary: Verify secure session token generation and management

Test Step Expected Result: Access with the invalidated token is not granted. Inference (low confidence): unauthorized session use must not succeed. Based on REQ-054.
